articles.title: Viral CCTV Shows Shops Shaking as 6.2 Magnitude Earthquake Rattles Venezuela & Colombia
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Caracas, Sept 24, 2025: A powerful 6.2-magnitude earthquake struck Venezuela’s Zulia province on Tuesday evening, with tremors felt across Colombia and the Caribbean islands. The quake’s epicentre was about 24 km east-northeast of Mene Grande (Zulia) at a shallow depth of 7.8 km.

body.html:
Caracas, Sept 24, 2025: A powerful 6.2-magnitude earthquake struck Venezuela’s Zulia province on Tuesday evening, with tremors felt across Colombia and the Caribbean islands.

The quake’s epicentre was about 24 km east-northeast of Mene Grande (Zulia) at a shallow depth of 7.8 km. Strong tremors shook Maracaibo, Caracas, Cúcuta, and Bucaramanga, forcing people to evacuate homes and buildings.

CCTV footage from a grocery shop in Zulia — showing shelves rattling and customers rushing out in panic — has gone viral on social media. Other videos captured falling household items, families fleeing homes, and damage to historic sites like Maracaibo’s Santa Bárbara Church.

Officials said around 2.3 lakh residents near the epicentre experienced strong to very strong shaking. However, there are no immediate reports of casualties or major structural damage, and authorities confirmed there was no tsunami risk.

Two aftershocks — magnitudes 3.9 and 5.4 — were also recorded in Zulia and Barinas states. Assessments are ongoing, particularly in heritage structures across Maracaibo.

Northwestern Venezuela, lying close to active tectonic boundaries, remains prone to seismic activity — posing risks to both residents and the country’s oil-rich infrastructure.

articles.title: Bhim Army Chief Chandrashekhar Azad Faces Sexual Harassment Row After PhD Scholar’s
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore/Switzerland, Sept 2025: Dr. Rohini Ghavari, a PhD scholar from Indore currently based in Switzerland, has publicly accused Chandrashekhar Azad, Bhim Army chief and MP from Nagina (UP), of sexual harassment, emotional exploitation, and deceit. Dr.

body.html:
Indore/Switzerland, Sept 2025: Dr. Rohini Ghavari, a PhD scholar from Indore currently based in Switzerland, has publicly accused Chandrashekhar Azad, Bhim Army chief and MP from Nagina (UP), of sexual harassment, emotional exploitation, and deceit.

Dr. Ghavari claims Azad manipulated her under the pretext of love and marriage, causing severe trauma that derailed her personal life and career. She also alleges that Azad has similarly mistreated other women, hiding facts about his marital status while using his political stature for undue influence.

In June 2025, she began raising her accusations on social media and later filed complaints with the National Commission for Women, claiming sustained threats and attempts to malign her.

On 23 September 2025, the matter escalated when Dr. Ghavari posted suicide threats online, explicitly naming Azad as responsible for her distress and tagging the Prime Minister in her appeals. The posts went viral, sparking a nationwide debate.

While the NCW and State Commissions for Women have initiated proceedings, Azad’s supporters and Bhim Army leaders have dismissed the charges as politically motivated, blaming rival parties for a smear campaign.

The controversy has since seen viral leaks of private chats, sharp caste debates (Jatav vs Valmiki communities), and growing calls for Azad’s suspension from Parliament if found guilty.

Dr. Ghavari, who identifies as an Ambedkarite, insists her fight is about justice rather than caste, though the matter has taken on wider social and political dimensions.

As of now, police and authorities have not confirmed any harm to Dr. Ghavari despite her suicide threats. The situation remains highly charged, with activists, political groups, and social media sharply divided.

articles.title: Pakistan’s Jaffar Express Bombed Again – Railways Under Siege in Balochistan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mastung (Balochistan), Sept 23, 2025: A powerful explosion once again targeted Pakistan’s troubled railway network, striking the Quetta-bound Jaffar Express in Mastung’s Dasht area.

body.html:
Mastung (Balochistan), Sept 23, 2025: A powerful explosion once again targeted Pakistan’s troubled railway network, striking the Quetta-bound Jaffar Express in Mastung’s Dasht area.

An IED planted on the tracks derailed six coaches, leaving at least a dozen passengers injured, including women and children. One carriage overturned completely, trapping several passengers until rescue teams rushed from Quetta.

Conflicting reports put the injured between 4 and 13, with at least five in critical condition.

This was the second attempt on the same train line in a single day. An earlier blast failed to cause damage, but this one struck with deadly precision.

The Jaffar Express has become a repeated target. In August 2025, an IED derailed six of its coaches. In March this year, militants of the Baloch Liberation Army (BLA) hijacked the train in Bolan, killing 31 people — including 23 soldiers — in one of Pakistan’s deadliest rail attacks.

Despite increased surveillance, drone patrols, and stricter inspections, Balochistan’s railways remain under relentless militant attacks. The cycle of violence shows no sign of ending.

articles.title: Ladakh Boils: Sonam Wangchuk Ends Hunger Strike Amid Violent Protests for Statehood
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Leh (Ladakh): Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk has ended his 15-day hunger strike after violent clashes broke out during a massive protest in Leh demanding statehood and Sixth Schedule safeguards for Ladakh.

body.html:
Leh (Ladakh): Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk has ended his 15-day hunger strike after violent clashes broke out during a massive protest in Leh demanding statehood and Sixth Schedule safeguards for Ladakh.

The protests, led largely by students and youth, turned violent near the Hill Council secretariat, where security forces used tear gas and baton charges to disperse demonstrators. The situation escalated into stone pelting and arson, with the BJP office in Leh and several police vehicles set on fire, sending thick plumes of smoke across the city.

Authorities have imposed curfew and restrictions under Section 163 of BNSS to contain the unrest. At least four people have died and over 30 others injured, including both protesters and police personnel.

Wangchuk condemned the violence, urging protesters to maintain peace, warning that bloodshed would harm the cause. He ended his fast, saying the focus should remain on dialogue and non-violent resistance.

The agitation, spearheaded by the Leh Apex Body (LAB) and supported by the Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA), reflects Ladakh’s growing frustration with the Centre over delays in meeting demands. Talks between Ladakh representatives and the central government are scheduled soon, but the clashes mark one of the most serious flashpoints in Ladakh’s political movement in recent years.

articles.title: Deoria Shock: Young Man in Burqa Caught Attempting to Meet Girl, Sparks Controversy
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Deoria (Uttar Pradesh): A dramatic incident unfolded at the Chorkhari intersection in Deoria (on the bases of report September 22, 2025 ) when villagers discovered that a burqa-clad individual, initially believed to be a woman, was actually a young man named Suhel.

body.html:
Deoria (Uttar Pradesh): A dramatic incident unfolded at the Chorkhari intersection in Deoria (on the bases of report September 22, 2025 ) when villagers discovered that a burqa-clad individual, initially believed to be a woman, was actually a young man named Suhel. The incident, captured on video, has gone viral on social media, drawing widespread attention and heated reactions.

According to reports, villagers became suspicious due to Suhel’s behaviour and voice. Upon confrontation and removal of the veil, Suhel admitted that he wore the burqa to conceal his identity while meeting a Hindu girl with whom he had studied. The revelation sparked outrage, with some locals accusing him of attempting to mislead the community and linking the incident to claims of so-called ‘love jihad’.

Police were alerted, and SHO Ranjeet Singh Bhadauria arrived with a force to control the situation. Suhel has been taken into custody for questioning. The SHO confirmed that further legal action will depend on a formal complaint from the girl’s family, which has not yet been filed.

Authorities are now investigating the nature of Suhel’s relationship with the girl, whether this was his first such meeting, and the reasons behind wearing the burqa. The girl and her family have not publicly commented, keeping the case in its preliminary stage.

articles.title: Woman, Lover and Accomplice Kill Neighbour to Frame Her Own Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh): In a shocking case that reads like a crime thriller, police in Moradabad uncovered a chilling conspiracy in which a young woman, along with her lover and his cousin, murdered a neighbour to falsely implicate her father and brothers in a murder case.

body.html:
Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh): In a shocking case that reads like a crime thriller, police in Moradabad uncovered a chilling conspiracy in which a young woman, along with her lover and his cousin, murdered a neighbour to falsely implicate her father and brothers in a murder case.

The accused — Swati (22), her boyfriend Manoj, and his cousin Manjeet — were arrested after a detailed investigation. Police said the conspiracy was inspired by crime shows, particularly Crime Patrol.

The Murder Plot:
Swati, a Class 10 pass, lived with her father Shobharam, mother Ramdei, and brothers Kapil and Gaurav in Guraitha village. Her family disapproved of her relationship with Manoj, a salon owner from Badaun. In frustration, Swati tried several times to poison her family by mixing sleeping pills in their food but failed.

Determined to remove them as obstacles, she told Manoj to either kill them or frame them in a false case. Manoj, taking cues from TV crime serials, came up with the idea of murdering someone else and framing Swati’s family.

On September 17, Manoj and Manjeet targeted Yogesh, a local painter. They laced his alcohol with sleeping pills, took him to a deserted graveyard area, and killed him brutally with a brick and strangulation.

Fake Call to Frame Family:
After the murder, Manoj used Yogesh’s phone to call UP-112, posing as the victim. In the call, he falsely accused Swati’s father and brothers of attacking him. The phone was left near the body.

Initially, police registered a murder case against Swati’s father and brothers, detaining them. But SSP Satpal Antil grew suspicious. On checking call records and voice samples, police found that the emergency call was not made by Yogesh.

Police Breakthrough & Encounter:
Further probe revealed Swati’s affair with Manoj and their conspiracy. Manoj and Manjeet were tracked down. During a police encounter near Pakbara, Manoj opened fire but was shot in the leg and captured. Both confessed to the crime, naming Swati as the mastermind.

All three — Swati, Manoj, and Manjeet — were arrested and sent to jail, while her father and brothers were released.

Police described the case as one of the most “chilling examples of how crime shows can influence real-life criminal conspiracies.”
